title: Lemma 3.3 (coordinate projection criterion), given Lemma 1.2
statement: Assume Simon Ch. 3, Lemma 1.2 in the form SubmanifoldCoverCharacterization: for all n, ℓ and M ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ}, M is countably n-rectifiable iff M ⊆ N₀ ∪ ⋃_j N_j with Hⁿ(N₀) = 0 and each N_j an n-dimensional embedded C¹ submanifold (IsC1Submanifold n). Then Lemma 3.3 (CoordinateProjectionCriterion) holds: for all n, ℓ ∈ ℕ and S ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ}, if Hⁿ(coordinateProjection J (S)) = 0 for every J ⊆ Fin(n+ℓ) with exactly n elements, then S is purely n-unrectifiable.
